title: the reservoir Rising
author: August Pemberton
blurb: August Coldharbour, an heir cataloging a parent's silence after the funeral, has spent ten years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
